description: Global constraints and instructions for the coding agent building the Transformer Playground.

constraints.format: Multi-file project. The entry point is transformer_playground.html which contains the HTML structure, all CSS in <style>, and loads JS via <script src> tags (NOT ES modules — plain scripts that set globals, so the page works when opened from the filesystem with no server). No external dependencies except Google Fonts (Outfit, Source Serif 4, JetBrains Mono).

file_structure.transformer_playground.html: HTML scaffolding, full CSS, <script src> tags in dependency order
file_structure.js/math-utils.js: Linear algebra utilities, vocabulary maps, tokenization — pure functions, no DOM
file_structure.js/weights.js: Rigged weight matrices for DNA and protein modes — depends on math-utils.js constants
file_structure.js/transformer.js: computeTransformer() forward pass — depends on math-utils.js and weights.js
file_structure.js/viz-helpers.js: Core reusable visualization renderers (matrix, token row, bar chart, analogy box, formula block, play button)
file_structure.js/viz-specialized.js: Specialized visualization components (SVG arrows, sinusoidal canvas, flow diagram, node diagram, distribution bars) — depends on viz-helpers.js

constraints.plan_reference: See 'Lecture 1/LLMs basic/plan.txt' for the full design specification. This is the authoritative source for all content, formulas, biology analogies, visualization specs, and design system details.
constraints.design_system: Distill.pub-inspired. Colors: DNA accent #2d7d9a, Protein accent #8b5a3c, Background #fafaf8, Cards white with 1px border/subtle shadow. Heatmap: cream→green (5-stop). Matrix: blue(neg)→white(zero)→red(pos). Fonts: Outfit (headings/UI), Source Serif 4 (body), JetBrains Mono (code/math).
constraints.toy_model_dims: seq_len=8 (user-editable 4-10), d_model=8, heads=4, d_k=2, d_ff=32, DNA vocab=4, protein vocab=20, layers=1
constraints.audience: Biology PhD students with weak programming skills. Explanations must be precise but accessible.
constraints.global_state_convention: All scripts communicate through a shared global object `window.TP` (Transformer Playground). Core engine scripts register functions on TP (e.g., TP.matMul, TP.computeTransformer). Visualization helpers register on TP.viz. Step scripts register their init/render functions on TP.steps. The main HTML calls TP.init() after all scripts load.

testing_workflow: You have access to Google Chrome for visual and functional testing. To open the file: open -a 'Google Chrome' '/Users/carli/Projects/EIPP_2026_LLMs_carli/Lecture 1/LLMs basic/transformer_playground.html'. After opening, take a screenshot to verify visually. Check the browser console (Cmd+Option+J) for JavaScript errors — zero console errors are required at every stage. Use screenshots to verify visual aesthetics match the Distill.pub style.

description: Implement linear algebra utility functions and vocabulary/tokenization logic. Also implement the vocabulary maps for DNA (A=0, T=1, G=2, C=3) and Protein (20 standard amino acids), tokenization functions, and the one-hot encoding utility. These are pure functions with no dependency on the DOM. All functions are registered on window.TP.

Vector ops: dot, magnitude, cosineSimilarity, argmax, scale. Matrix ops: matAdd, addBias, zeros, zerosVec, oneHot, getRow, sliceCols, concatCols. Tokenize/detokenize for DNA and Protein modes. All constants: D_MODEL=8, N_HEADS=4, D_K=2, D_FF=32. 31/31 tests pass in Node.js. All 7 PRD browser tests pass in Chrome. Zero console errors.
context: See 'Lecture 1/LLMs basic/plan.txt' 'Toy Model Dimensions' section. d_model=8, heads=4, d_k=2, d_ff=32, DNA vocab=4, Protein vocab=20. Protein vocab order: A,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,K,L,M,N,P,Q,R,S,T,V,W,Y (alphabetical standard). description: Create all rigged weight matrices — embeddings, attention weights (W_Q/W_K/W_V/W_O for all 4 heads), FFN weights (W1, b1, W2, b2), and output projection (W_vocab, b_vocab) — pre-seeded deterministically to produce biologically meaningful patterns as described in plan.txt's 'Rigged Weight Strategy'. Store in TP.WEIGHTS keyed by mode ('dna'/'protein').
resolution_notes: Iteration 3: Implemented all rigged weight matrices. DNA: embeddings with complementary base pair opposition (cosA-T=-0.88, cosG-C=-0.98). Protein: 20 amino acid embeddings organized by physicochemical properties — hydrophobic cluster (cosL-V=0.86), charged cluster (cosK-R=0.94, cosD-E=0.94), cross-class negative. 4 attention heads per mode with biologically meaningful rigging: Head 0 complementary/hydrophobic, Head 1 local context, Head 2 purine-pyrimidine/charge, Head 3 diffuse. W_O near-identity, FFN seeded random, output projection biased toward biological predictions. Seeded PRNG for full reproducibility. 34/34 tests pass. Zero console errors.
context: See 'Lecture 1/LLMs basic/plan.txt' 'Rigged Weight Strategy' section. DNA mode: A/T near-opposite embeddings (complementary base pairs), G/C likewise. Head 0: boosted complementary base attention (A↔T, G↔C). Head 1: strong local/neighbor attention (±1 position). Heads 2-3: more diffuse. Output biased toward complement of last base. Protein mode: hydrophobic cluster (L,V,I,F,W,M,A), charged cluster (K,R,D,E), small/polar cluster (S,T,N,Q,G). Head 0: hydrophobic-to-hydrophobic. Head 1: charged-to-charged. Head 2: local backbone (±2). Head 3: diffuse. Output biased toward same physicochemical class as masked residue. Store all weights in TP.WEIGHTS keyed by mode ('dna'/'protein'). Uses TP.D_MODEL, TP.N_HEADS, etc. from math-utils.js.
testing: Open in Chrome (see meta.testing_workflow). Use browser console to verify: (1) DNA embeddings: TP.cosineSimilarity between A and T rows — should be strongly negative (near-opposite), (2) G and C similarly near-opposite, (3) Protein embeddings: cosine(L_embed, V_embed) > cosine(L_embed, K_embed) — hydrophobic cluster tighter than hydrophobic-to-charged, (4) All weight matrices have correct dimensions: embedding 4×8 (DNA) / 20×8 (protein), W_Q/W_K/W_V are 8×2 per head, W_O is 8×8, W1 is 8×32, W2 is 32×8, W_vocab is 8×4 (DNA) / 8×20 (protein). Zero console errors.

description: Implement the full transformer forward pass pipeline function TP.computeTransformer(sequence, mode) that takes an input sequence string and mode, runs tokenization → embedding lookup → positional encoding → self-attention (all 4 heads) → multi-head concatenation + W_O → residual + LayerNorm → FFN → residual + LayerNorm → output projection → softmax, and returns ALL intermediate representations in a structured object.
resolution_notes: Iteration 4: Full transformer forward pass implemented. Pipeline: tokenize → embedding lookup → sinusoidal PE → 4-head attention (causal mask for DNA, bidirectional for protein) → concat + W_O → residual + LayerNorm → FFN (ReLU) → residual + LayerNorm → output projection → softmax. Returns all 16 intermediates for visualization. DNA ATGCGATC predicts G (38.3%, complement of C). All 4 complement predictions work (A→T, T→A, G→C, C→G). Protein MAGLVKRD predicts R. Calibrated DNA W_vocab against actual final representations. Also exposed computePositionalEncoding for Step 3 visualization. Zero console errors.
context: Uses TP.matMul, TP.softmax, TP.relu, TP.layerNorm, TP.tokenize from math-utils.js and TP.WEIGHTS from weights.js. Positional encoding: PE(pos,2i) = sin(pos/10000^{2i/d_model}), PE(pos,2i+1) = cos(...). Causal mask in DNA mode: set scores to -Infinity for positions j > i before softmax. No mask in protein mode (bidirectional). The function must return a structured object with ALL intermediates: {tokenIds, embeddings, positionalEncodings, positionedEmbeddings, qkvPerHead: [{Q, K, V, scores, scaledScores, mask, attention, headOutput}], multiHeadOutput, postResidual1, postLayerNorm1, ffnHidden, ffnOutput, postResidual2, postLayerNorm2, logits, probabilities, predictedToken}. This object is consumed by every step's visualization. Register as TP.computeTransformer.

Use browser console to test: (1) DNA 'ATGCGATC': result.tokenIds = [0,1,2,3,2,0,1,3], (2) result.embeddings is 8×8, (3) result.positionedEmbeddings differs from result.embeddings (PE added), (4) result.qkvPerHead has 4 entries, each with Q/K/V of shape 8×2, (5) Head 0 attention rows sum to 1.0, (6) DNA mode: attention[i][j]=0 for j>i (causal mask), (7) Protein mode: no such restriction, (8) result.ffnHidden has shape 8×32, some values are 0 (ReLU), (9) result.probabilities sums to 1.0, (10) result.predictedToken is a valid token string, (11) For DNA 'ATGCGATC', predicted token leans toward G (complement of C). Zero console errors.

description: Implement Step 4 (Self-Attention Deep Dive) — the most complex and interactive step. Four animated sub-stages with Play button: (1) Q, K, V matrices (head 0, tokens × d_k), (2) raw scores QK^T (tokens × tokens), (3) scaling ÷√d_k + causal mask (blacked-out cells in DNA mode), (4) softmax attention heatmap (cream-to-green, rows sum to 1). Clickable heatmap cells trigger SVG arrows between tokens.
resolution_notes: Implemented step-4-attention.js with 4 animated sub-stages: (1) Q/K/V matrices side-by-side 8x2 each with blue-white-red, (2) raw scores QK^T 8x8, (3) scaled scores with causal mask (28 dark upper-triangle cells in DNA, 0 in protein), (4) softmax attention heatmap cream-to-green with clickable cells. Custom renderMaskedMatrix for dark masked cells. Click any cell → renderArrows draws SVG bezier curves on token row below. Play button triggers sequential fade-in animation. Auto-runs on first render. Text: Q/K/V as looking-for/contain/pass-along, scaling rationale, mode-dependent masking paragraph. Biology analogy: residue contact map / DCA comparison. Formula block with all equations. All 9 PRD tests pass: dimensions correct, causal mask verified, row sums = 1.0000, arrows render on click, protein mode has no mask, zero console errors.
context: See 'Lecture 1/LLMs basic/plan.txt' Step 4. Shows only head 0 (multi-head is Step 5). Formulas: Q=XW_Q, K=XW_K, V=XW_V, scores=QK^T, scaled=scores/√d_k, masked: scaled+M where M_ij=-∞ if j>i (DNA), attn=softmax(masked), output=attn·V. The 4 sub-stages animate sequentially with visual continuity. Causal mask: dark overlay on upper-triangle cells. Final heatmap: cream-to-green, clickable. Clicking cell (i,j) draws an arrow from token j to token i proportional to attn[i][j]. Text: Q='What am I looking for?', K='What do I contain?', V='What should I pass along?'. Biology analogy: contact map / DCA comparison. Data from TP.state.qkvPerHead[0]. Register TP.steps[4] = { init, render }.

Iteration 14: Final integration QA pass complete. All 15 JS files load without errors. window.TP fully populated (math, weights, transformer, viz, steps[0-9]). DNA mode end-to-end: all 10 steps render correctly, heatmap clicks produce arrows, Play buttons animate, matrices have hover tooltips. Protein mode: mode toggle updates all steps (text, analogies, visualizations, accent colors, defaults). elements from HTML. Total size 328KB (under 500KB). Zero console errors throughout all testing.
context: The full plan is in 'Lecture 1/LLMs basic/plan.txt'. This is the final quality pass. The entry point is transformer_playground.html which loads all JS via <script src> tags. It must work by double-clicking or opening in any browser (file:// protocol). Target audience: biology PhD students using this as a 1-hour interactive tutorial. Every interaction must be smooth. Edge cases: Step 0 no Back, Step 9 no Next (or shows Restart), progress dots reflect current step, mode toggle updates everything, short sequences (4 tokens) don't break layout, long sequences (10 tokens) don't overflow. Total file size across all files must be under 500KB.

(3) Complete Steps 0-9 in DNA mode: interact with EVERY visualization — click heatmap cells, press Play buttons, hover matrices, click flow chart boxes. (4) Return to Step 0, toggle to Protein, complete Steps 0-9 again. (5) Step 1: change input to 'AAAA' (4 tokens) → verify all steps handle it without layout breakage. (6) Change to 'ATGCGATCAT' (10 tokens) → verify. (7) Click every progress bar dot. (8) Test Back/Next edge cases. (9) Hover over every matrix cell in Steps 2-5. (10) Click cells in Steps 4-5 → arrows appear. (11) Press all Play buttons (Steps 4, 6, 7). (12) Zero console errors throughout. (13) Responsive layout at ~700px. (14) Verify total file size < 500KB with: du -sh 'Lecture 1/LLMs basic/js/' && wc -c 'Lecture 1/LLMs basic/transformer_playground.html'. (15) Test opening from filesystem (file://) — no CORS errors. Take final screenshots in both modes.
